# Captured output

What a program wrote and how it ended, kept by [`Command::Capture`](/docs/api/process/command#capture).

<h2 id="captured-output"><code>CapturedOutput</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct CapturedOutput {
    // private fields
}
```

What a program wrote to its standard output and error, and how it finished.
The bytes are kept as the program wrote them, which is usually but not always UTF-8. Not copied.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Process/Src/Capture.rux#L14)
